title: Embedding INT8/FP16 Robustness Audit and Recalibration Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce an actionable playbook to audit embedding models after INT8 and FP16 quantization, run nightly recalibration jobs, and gate deployments via angular-similarity (cosine) regression checks. Scope covers model variants used in the embeddings catalog, the nightly calibration harness, gating thresholds for canaries, and operational runbook steps for out-of-band rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly calibration job runs for all active embedding models (>=95% coverage) and uploads calibration artifacts to s3://redwood/quant-calib/
Automated similarity regression checks detect mean cosine drop > 0.012 or top-1 hit rate fall > 1.5% and open alert to #infra-quant with playbook link
Canary rollout requires similarity pass for 3 consecutive runs before traffic shift beyond 10%
Recalibration procedure documented and executable by on-call within 30 minutes
Bench harness reports: median cosine, 5/95 percentile distributions, and per-corpus deltas for each quant profile
runbook: 1) Kickoff: trigger nightly-calib workflow: ci/quant-nightly (cron 02:00 UTC). 2) Calibration: for each model run calib-cli --model {model} --profile INT8,FP16 --samples 50k --seed 2025. 3) Metrics upload: upload artifacts: aws s3 cp out/{model} s3://redwood/quant-calib/{date}/{model}/ --recursive. 4) Validation: run sim-check --baseline s3://redwood/embedding-baselines/{model}/fp16 --candidate s3://redwood/quant-calib/{date}/{model}/int8 --metric cosine --min-mean-drop -0.012 --top1-drop 0.015. 5) Gate: if validation FAIL -> create incident and mark canary blocked; notify #infra-quant; if PASS -> annotate release with quant-signature and proceed with canary. 6) Manual recalibration: if automatic recal fails, run recalibrate-interactive {model} and follow manual anchor sampling steps. Logs: /var/log/quant-calib/

Model: embed-legal-v1 | FP16 baseline median cosine: 0.9125 | INT8 candidate median cosine: 0.9010 | mean drop: 0.0115 (flagged borderline)
Corpus-level: support-logs showed top1-hit drop 2.1% for INT8 -> trigger for manual review
Bootstrap CI (n=1000 samples) p-value for mean similarity change < 0.01 for embed-legal-v1 -> requires recalibration
rollout_plan: Canary step 1: 1% traffic to INT8 profile for 24h with continuous sim-checks
Canary step 2: 10% traffic for 24h upon 3 consecutive similarity passes
Full rollout: 100% only after 48h stability and no alerts
Rollback: automatic re-route to FP16 if a sim-check fails in production or latency/regression SLOs violated
notes: Trade-offs: tighter gating reduces customer risk but increases ops friction and rollbacks; propose per-corpus thresholds to balance false positives vs. false negatives.
Decision: prefer periodic anchor refresh over larger sampling to keep runtime cost bounded (agreed 2025-02-22).
Next steps: automate per-model anchor generation and add an isolation mode for KB corpora to run higher-sample calibrations.
